summary: Most of the frustration centres on gender dynamics, followed by dating culture & communication and algorithm & match quality. Users report superficial interactions, lack of meaningful conversation, and childish behavior. Many feel the app encourages shallow communication and lacks depth in conversations, leading to frustration and disengagement.

themes.name: Dating Culture & Communication
themes.description: Users report superficial interactions, lack of meaningful conversation, and childish behavior. Many feel the app encourages shallow communication and lacks depth in conversations, leading to frustration and disengagement.
themes.recommendation: Improve conversation prompts, encourage deeper interactions, and foster more mature communication norms.

themes.name: Safety & Moderation

themes.name: Algorithm & Match Quality
themes.description: Users report issues with the algorithm's fairness, match suggestions, and the impact of signals on engagement. The new signals feature is criticized for rewarding activity over meaningful connections.
themes.recommendation: Refine algorithm to prioritize quality over quantity, improve match suggestions, and rethink the signals feature.

themes.name: Gender Dynamics
themes.description: Women report being overwhelmed by attention, facing harassment, and experiencing ghosting. There's a perception of imbalance in attention and respect.
themes.recommendation: Implement stronger anti-harassment policies, improve user reporting, and promote respectful behavior norms.
